data.name: Poojani
data.long_meaning: The name Poojani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'poojana' which means 'to offer prayers'. This name is often given to a girl born in a Hindu family who is believed to be a Goddess in her own right, and is blessed with the ability to bring happiness and blessings to her family and community through her prayers and devotion.
